assessments.phrase: safe distance in advance of the vehicle
assessments.reason: The authored road contains an opposed vehicle but no independently identified forward person or target vehicle at a graded range. The camera and beam-request bit do not quantify illumination sufficient to reveal one. A numeric legal safe distance is not supplied and must not be invented.
needed_for_complete_sweep: Source-identified forward targets with measured distance and visibility in original frames
Verified physical control parameter that changes target illumination over a feasible numeric range
Stable camera/exposure or calibrated light evidence, range feasibility and frozen spacing

assessments.phrase: glaring rays are not projected into the eyes of the oncoming driver
assessments.reason: The driver-reference camera and lamp readback preserve a review path, but the oncoming actor has no verified driver-eye region and CARLA's low/high flag is not an emitted-ray or eye-exposure measurement. No numeric optical sweep axis is currently supported by the construction.
needed_for_complete_sweep: Original eye-region identification and reproducible pixel/ray observation
Numeric physical setpoint with verified effect on original light at that region
Fixed geometry, exposure, weather, feasible range and frozen spacing

assessments.phrase: lowermost distribution of light, or composite beam, specified in subsection 2 of NRS 484D.210
assessments.reason: The frozen inputs do not provide the incorporated NRS 484D.210(2) equipment specification. The Native low-beam flag cannot establish statutory lowermost-distribution identity. The selected direct optical review route does not invoke deeming.
needed_for_complete_sweep: Exact incorporated equipment specification and authenticated source
Original headlamp configuration/readback mapped to that specification
If deeming is invoked, a supported graded physical parameter and frozen measurement plan
